# Yard Dog Landscapes

> Family-owned landscaping and lawn care company serving Longview and East Texas since 2017. Rated 5.0 stars across 143 Google reviews, fully insured, with free written quotes. Request a quote at https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/contact.

Yard Dog Landscapes is a residential and commercial landscaping company based in Longview, Texas. We provide lawn maintenance, landscape design and installation, hardscaping, retaining walls, drainage, sod, mulch, fertilization, leaf removal with a leaf vacuum (no bags), irrigation and sprinkler systems (Texas Licensed Irrigator LI0006657), and Christmas light installation across Gregg, Harrison, Smith, Rusk, Upshur, Panola, and Nacogdoches counties in East Texas.

## Company
- [About Yard Dog Landscapes](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/about): Family-owned in Longview since 2017, owned by Miller Maines. Built on showing up, doing the work right, and giving customers more than they pay for.
- [Our Work](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work): 174 photos and the crew's own videos of real East Texas projects, with a page for each job.
- [Pricing](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/pricing): Published price ranges. Weekly mowing from $65 per visit; landscaping $900 to $3,600; patios $3,100 to $9,100; retaining walls $3,000 to $19,000; drainage $2,000 to $3,750; sod $1,500 to $4,700; Christmas lights from $900 (from $1,800 more than an hour from Longview).
- [Service areas](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/service-areas): All 13 East Texas towns we serve, each with its own page.
- [Design Preview](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/design-preview): Flat-rate landscape design renderings ($199, $449, $999).

## Projects
- [Flagstone Patio by the Pool in Hallsville, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/flagstone-patio-hallsville-tx) (2 videos and photos): A rounded flagstone patio off the end of a backyard pool in Hallsville, built so the family has a place for nightly outdoor campfires.
- [Irrigation System & Bermuda Sod Install in Longview, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/irrigation-sod-installation-longview-tx) (2 videos and photos): A bare Longview yard turned into a watered Bermuda lawn: new irrigation lines and zones, 30 yards of topsoil, about 32 sprinkler heads and 19 pallets of Bermuda sod.
- [90-Foot Flagstone Walkway with Path Lights in Kilgore, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/flagstone-walkway-kilgore-tx) (2 videos and photos): A 90-foot flagstone walkway in Kilgore with chopped stone borders, two new azalea beds and landscape lighting running all the way to the back porch.
- [Raised Boat & RV Pad with a Timber Retaining Wall in White Oak, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/boat-rv-pad-white-oak-tx) (2 videos and photos): The ground beside this White Oak shed didn't line up with it, so our crew built a pressure-treated timber retaining wall, filled it and topped it with crushed concrete for a level boat and RV pad.
- [Flagstone Patio & Chopped Stone Fire Pit in White Oak, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/flagstone-patio-fire-pit-white-oak-tx) (video and photos): About 475 square feet of Cherokee flagstone with chopped stone edging around a chopped stone fire pit. One corner sits up on a chopped stone wall where the yard falls away.
- [A Weekly Lawn Care Route Around Longview, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/weekly-lawn-care-route-longview-tx) (video and photos): A day on one of our weekly routes around Longview: mowing with stand-on and walk-behind mowers, string trimming, edging and blowing off every walk and drive.
- [Driveway Retaining Wall Rebuild at Lake Cherokee, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/driveway-retaining-wall-lake-cherokee-tx) (photos): A leaning block wall along a driveway pulled out and rebuilt course by course on a compacted base, with drainage fabric and pipe behind it.
- [Checkerboard Paver Patio in Kilgore, TX](https://www.yarddoglandscapes.com/our-work/checkerboard-paver-patio-kilgore-tx) (photos): A worn-out backyard off a covered brick porch turned into a checkerboard concrete paver patio with gravel joints, laid out on a compacted base.
